india-macro.summary: The World Bank report highlights that nearly 50 crore Indians have moved out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. The court found that the authority granting the sanction did not apply proper judgment to the circumstances. Chanda Kochhar was arrested in December 2022 and received interim bail in January 2023. The case involved a loan of Rs 3,250 crore given to Videocon Group during her tenure.
